newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt offers stake in development bank.
newsitem.headline: Egypt offers stake in development bank.

text.p: The Egyptian state said in a statement published on Saturday it was offering a first tranche of 600,000 shares in National Bank for Development.
The state-owned National Investment Bank said bids would take place through brokers from April 29 to May 1 and would be displayed in the Cairo and Alexandria bourses from May 4 to May 5.
The price would be set according to the prevailing bid price but not less than 28 pounds. Investors must buy at least 100 shares.

NBD's capital in the financial year ending on December 31, 1996 was 150.684 million pounds. Its shares have a nominal value of 10.00 pounds and last traded on the Cairo stock exchange on Thursday at 25.41 pounds.
NBD made 30.9 million pounds profit in 1996, up from 24.669 million pounds in 1995. It had shareholders' equity worth 242.8 million pounds in 1996, up from 152.717 million pounds.
